title: Reading Drill — Reducing paper waste at a college — A pilot study
description: One short passage, six questions. Recommended time: 10 minutes.

passages.title: Reducing paper waste at a college — A pilot study
passages.body:
**A** A project in Elmbrook began with reports of drafts being printed on both new and recycled sheets. The print room clerk had heard several complaints, but individual reports could not show how often the problem occurred. The team collected evidence using bin audits and chose sheets of unused paper discarded as its main measure. That allowed it to compare different days using the same rule.

**B** The proposed response was a labelled draft printer. Rather than apply it immediately across the whole site, the team ran a trial in a single area. The trial lasted five weeks. A second area kept its previous arrangements, making it possible to see whether any change occurred at both sites.

**C** The first review recorded deadlines for coursework as a factor that could affect the comparison. The team advised repeating the study under different conditions before drawing a wider conclusion. It kept the evidence from the first trial but published a note about why the figures might not apply elsewhere.
